narrative: 海报、寓言、一张政治静照：把两种色相分别指定给阴影和亮部，或指定给人物和背景，然后消灭其他所有颜色。局部色彩可以附着在一件大衣、一个人身上，或世界的某种变化状态上。
写实的皮肤色可能会打破这条法则，除非其中一种色相就是肤色本身。当作一种温和的调色来用，它是错误的工具；如果随机的颜色在运动中渗透出来，也是错误的用法。
这个选定的色彩必须保持稳定。多出来的用墨是一种渗漏，而不是丰富度。
how: 固定机位，35mm到50mm焦段。规划好服装和墙面，让画面里只剩下两种色相，然后用蒙版或调色把其余部分归入这两种颜色，或归入单色再加一个点缀色。
明确说出这两种色相。Prompt: Two-color law on [Subject], a pair of hues doing all the drawing, print as cinematography. Name the two hues.
when: 一张海报、一则寓言、一张政治静照、一件必须是画面中唯一颜色的大衣。不要把它当作青橙色调的大片调色来用，也不要让多余的色相渗漏进来。
vs: 限定色板（Palette）是一套受限的色彩集合，但依然可以超过两种颜色。单色（Monochrome）只用一种墨色。
双色调则是两种颜色，或单色加一个点缀色。如果还有其他颜色残留，你想要的是限定色板，或者说你没有遵守这条法则。
examples_film: 《辛德勒的名单》（Schindler's List）在单色画面中，把那件红色大衣保留为一个信号。《欢乐谷》（Pleasantville）让色彩的出现代表一种状态的转变。
《罪恶之城》（Sin City）在高对比度的单色画面中，用选定的几种颜色作点缀。这是法则，不是一个LUT。
保持这个色彩选定的稳定。
mistakes: 青橙色调的大片调色，或随机的渗漏。破绽是无数的颜色残留。
修正方法：只用两种色相，明确指定，在遮挡中也保持稳定。

faq.q: 电影中的双色调（Two Color）是什么？
faq.a: 一种双色或局部色彩的法则：两种色相完成所有的绘制，或在一个单色世界中，某个物体保留着颜色。这是把印刷法则当作摄影来用，而不是一种温和的调色。

faq.q: 双色调（Two Color）与单色（Monochrome）的区别
faq.a: 单色只用一种墨色。双色调是两种颜色，或单色加一个选定的信号色。如果一切都是灰色的，你想要的是单色。如果一件大衣保持红色，你就属于这个家族。
海报、寓言、政治静照、一个反复出现的颜色信号。跳过青橙色调的残留和渗漏的蒙版。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写双色调的提示词？
faq.a: 先说明这两种色相、规划好服装，然后消灭其他所有颜色。让这条法则在运动中保持稳定。

narrative: Posters, fables, a political still: assign the two hues to shadow and light, or to figure and ground, then kill everything else. Spot color can attach to a coat, a person, or a changing state of the world.
Naturalistic skin may break the law unless one hue is the skin. It is the wrong tool as a mild grade, and the wrong tool if random colors leak through motion.
The selection must stay stable. Complexity of extra inks is a leak, not richness.
how: Lock off, 35mm to 50mm. Plan wardrobe and walls so only two hues survive, then mask or grade the rest to the pair or to monochrome plus one.
Prompt: Two-color law on [Subject], a pair of hues doing all the drawing, print as cinematography. Name the two hues.
when: A poster, a fable, a political still, a coat that must be the only color. Do not use it as teal-orange blockbuster, and do not let extra hues leak.
vs: Palette is a restricted set that may still hold more than two. Monochrome is one ink.
Two color is a pair, or monochrome plus a spot. If leftovers survive, you wanted palette, or you failed the law.
examples_film: Schindler's List keeps the red coat as a signal inside monochrome. Pleasantville lets color arrive as a change of state.
Sin City punctuates high-contrast monochrome with selected inks. Law, not a LUT.
mistakes: A teal-orange blockbuster, or random leaks. The tell is a thousand leftovers.
Fix it: two hues only, assigned, stable through occlusion.

faq.q: What is Two Color in film?
faq.a: A duotone or spot-color law: two hues do all the drawing, or one object keeps color in a monochrome world. Print as cinematography, not a mild grade.
Monochrome is one ink. Two color is a pair, or monochrome plus a chosen signal. If everything is grey, you wanted monochrome. If a coat stays red, you are in this family.

faq.q: When should I use Two Color?
faq.a: Posters, fables, political stills, a recurring color signal. Skip teal-orange leftovers and leaky masks.

faq.q: How do I prompt Two Color for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name the two hues, plan wardrobe, then: Two-color law on [Subject], a pair of hues doing all the drawing, print as cinematography. Kill every other ink. Keep the rule stable in motion.
